content_sections.heading: RITES Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for GM (Team Leader / Metro works), 1 for JGM (Geotechnical Expert / Metro works) and 1 for DGM (Architect / Metro works).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and make the fee payment is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the posts of GM (Team Leader / Metro works), JGM (Geotechnical Expert / Metro works), and DGM (Architect / Metro works).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the RITES posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post, including Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Master's Degree in Geotechnical Engineering, and Bachelor's Degree in Architecture.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 600/- plus applicable taxes.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these RITES positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the GM (Team Leader / Metro works) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the GM (Team Leader / Metro works) post ranges from INR 1,00,000 to INR 2,60,000.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online through the official RITES website.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these RITES positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Regular.
